common.empty: Nothing here yet. The Ledger waits.
common.error: The ink ran dry. Tap to try again.

boot.line: The Tablet does not forgive. Neither, I find, do I.

notes.select: Tap an empty cell. The brass edge marks your hand.
notes.place: Now tap a numeral below. Correct ink is final; it cannot be undone.
notes.mistake: A false hand errs. You lost one wax Seal — see the pips above.
notes.pencil: Toggle the quill to pencil candidates. Notes never cost Seals.
notes.claim: Complete a row, column, or box to claim it and wound your foe. I am… not hurrying.
notes.augur: The Eye reveals the true digit in a chosen cell. One use, freely given.
notes.end: Break my Seals, or fill the Tablet first. Begin, Clerk.

concedeConfirm.title: Withdraw the plea?
concedeConfirm.body: To concede is to forfeit the duel and the Standing wagered on it.

log.mistakeForgiven: {player}'s hand errs — Marginalia bears the cost.
log.claimDeferred: {unit} is complete, but Quarantine stays the claim.
log.ink: {player} completes the claimed {unit}. Ink is earned.
log.suddenJudgment: Sudden Judgment. The hour is spent.
log.reckoningWin: The Tablet is complete. By Reckoning, {player} prevails.
log.waiting: The Tablet is set. Your foe studies their hand.

swap.title: He adapts.
swap.note: Fresh rites. The passive returns. Mind your Seals.

disconnect.title: The line is severed
disconnect.peerBody: {who} has left the hall. {s}s before the plea is forfeit.
disconnect.youOffline: Your line to the court frays. Rekindling the wax…

duel.waitingShade: No human answers the summons. A Shade will take the plea.

orders.selectSub: Take an Order. It fights as you do.

scholar.name: Scholar
scholar.passive: Marginalia — your first mistake each duel costs no Seal.

augur.name: Augur
augur.desc: Reveal the correct digit in the selected empty cell.

unseal.name: Unseal
unseal.desc: Clear all statuses on your board and become immune for 6s.

fairCopy.name: Fair Copy
fairCopy.desc: Auto-fill correct pencil candidates for the selected box.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.passive: Last Rites — your claims deal +1 when the foe has 3 or fewer Seals.

sever.name: Sever
sever.desc: Chain the empty cell in the foe's most nearly complete unit for 8s.

hush.name: Hush
hush.desc: The foe's number pad is dead for 2.5s.

apothecary.name: Apothecary
apothecary.passive: Distiller — statuses you apply last 2s longer.

smudge.name: Smudge
smudge.desc: Blur 5 of the foe's placed digits for 7s.

tincture.name: Tincture
tincture.desc: Restore 1 Seal (max 7). Two vials per duel.

miasma.name: Miasma
miasma.desc: Erase the foe's notes and bar pencil for 10s.

warden.name: Warden
warden.passive: Bulwark — the first incoming status each duel is negated.

ward.name: Ward
ward.desc: Negate the next incoming status within 15s.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.desc: Reflect the next incoming status back within 10s.

quarantine.name: Quarantine
quarantine.desc: A unit you choose cannot be claimed by the foe for 12s.

hub.enterSub: A ranked duel against flesh or Shade
hub.dailySub: One Tablet. One day. Unbroken Days: {streak}
hub.foliosSettled: The Ledger is {ending}. The Endless Assize continues.
hub.friendSub: Share a link, settle it between you
hub.practiceSub: Any difficulty. No witness, small reward.
hub.echoesSub: Duel the ink of Clerks who came before
hub.endlessSub: Rung {rung} · best {best}. The circuit never ends.
hub.weeklySub: This week: {mods}. One sitting. Every Clerk.

endless.title: The Endless Assize
endless.sub: The Nine ride their circuit again, forever. Every third rung is a Magistrate's duel — eight Seals and their arc.
endless.law: A win sets you one rung higher. A loss returns you to the foot of the stair — what you climbed stays written.

weekly.title: The Weekly Assize
weekly.sub: The court sits under different law each week. Two writs, read aloud, bind both duelists — the same two, for every Clerk, until the bells mark the next Monday.
weekly.satLine: The seal of this week is set. Re-sit freely — the ledger is written.
weekly.endsLabel: The writs turn over in {days} d {hours} h
weekly.law: One completion per week. The first win mints {ink} Ink — the rule changes cut both ways.

matchmaking.title: Summoning
lines: The summons is nailed to the court door.
A clerk counts the queue, slowly.
Somewhere, a Seal is being warmed.
The Ledger opens to a fresh page.
Your name is read aloud to an empty hall.
A Shade sharpens itself on your Standing.
The bells mark the hour. No one else comes.
matchmaking.shadeFallback: No human answers. A Shade takes the plea.

reliquary.title: The Reliquary
reliquary.ratesBody: Common 60% · Rare 30% · Fabled 10%. Duplicates become 40 Ink. Cosmetics only; the Assize cannot be bought.
reliquary.duplicate: A duplicate. Its Ink is yours.

daily.title: Daily Assize
daily.sub: One puzzle per day, the same for every soul in Novem.
daily.attempted: Today's Tablet is spent. Offer a Candle for another.
daily.mistakeNote: Each mistake adds 10s to your reckoning.
daily.emptyBoard: No one has plead today. Be first.
daily.candleNote: A second attempt. +20 Ink to the poor-box. Three candles a day.

cabinet.title: The Cabinet
cabinet.patronNote: Sigils buy cosmetics only. Never an edge.

ledger.title: The Great Ledger
ledger.recoveryBody: Four words and a checksum. They restore your Standing and purchases on another device. Keep them as you would keep your life.

settings.title: Settings
settings.colorblindNote: Claims and statuses carry shapes as well as colour.
settings.telemetryNote: Duel start, end, and screen views. First-party only.
settings.deleteConfirm: Every Seal, every folio, every sin — expunged. This cannot be undone.
settings.aboutBody: ASSIZE. A duel of nines, set down in ink. Engine, art and rites are local; no account is made of you.
settings.privacyBody: No email. No trackers. A guest number lives on your device. The court keeps your Standing, your daily times, and nothing that names you.

offline.title: The gates are sealed
offline.body: The Assize cannot be reached. The tutorial, the Folios, practice and Shade duels remain open to you.
offline.errorBody: Something failed. The Ledger notes all failures.

purse.title: The Clerk's Purse
purse.ink: Ink is earned by every plea — win or lose.
purse.sigils: Sigils are rare. They buy cosmetics, never advantage.
purse.reliquary: Every third win, the Reliquary opens.

echoes.title: Shade Echoes
echoes.sub: A Shade is an ink-echo that duels on a Clerk's behalf. Each shelf below holds the recorded ink of a real duel — take it up and face it.
echoes.empty: The shelf is bare. Duel, and your ink will echo here.
echoes.degraded: Some echoes failed to settle and rest as ordinary Shades.
echoes.yourShadeSub: Your newest ink, turned against you — it paces as you paced, errs as you erred, casts as you cast.
echoes.yourShadeFaint: The newest ink is too faint to read. An ordinary Shade answers in your echo's name.
echoes.sealChit: Seal a chit — pass this echo on
echoes.chitBody: The chit carries the ink of the duel — the tablet, the rites, the faltering hand — but no names. Pass it to another Clerk.
echoes.copied: Sealed — the chit is on your clipboard.
echoes.copyFail: The wax would not take. Copy the chit by hand:
echoes.importChit: Break a chit another Clerk sealed
echoes.importBad: The chit is broken or forged — nothing to read.
echoes.importOk: The echo takes its place on the shelf.
echoes.privacyNote: A shared chit never carries names — only ink.

friend.title: Friend Duel
friend.waiting: Waiting for your friend to break the seal…

practice.title: Practice
practice.sub: No witness. Small Ink, once a day.

endingChoice.title: The Ninth Seal is broken.
endingChoice.sub: Two verdicts remain, Clerk, and only your hand holds the pen. Whatever you write here is written into the Ledger for good.
endingChoice.balanceDesc: The truth, read aloud in the hall. It will cost you what it cost him.
endingChoice.burnDesc: Every debt to ash. The city goes free — and nothing holds it up.
endingChoice.confirmBody: The choice is remembered in your save. It cannot be un-written.
endingChoice.hint: Press 1 or 2 — or tap a verdict

clean-hand.title: A Clean Hand
clean-hand.desc: Win a duel with zero mistakes.

seal-breaker.title: Seal-Breaker
seal-breaker.desc: Break all seven of a foe's Seals in one duel.

box-wright.title: Box-Wright
box-wright.desc: Claim all nine boxes in one duel.

hush-proof.title: Unspoken
hush-proof.desc: Win a duel you were Hushed in twice.

unchained.title: Unchained
unchained.desc: Win with three Chains set upon your board.

smudge-reader.title: Reader of Blots
smudge-reader.desc: Win a duel with five of your digits smudged.

reckoning-dealt.title: Reckoning Dealt
reckoning-dealt.desc: Win a claim while Reckoning is armed.

endless-ten.title: Tenth Rung
endless-ten.desc: Clear ten rungs of the Endless Assize.

loading: Wax is warmed. Hands are steadied.
The Ninefold Court convenes in candlelight.
A Clerk grinds ink that will not be enough.
The Great Ledger creaks open to your page.
Bells count nine, then silence.
A Shade rehearses your defeat, politely.
Plague-seals are painted on the gate again.
The Headsman whets his patience.
Mother Vael counts drops. Slowly.
A bell-rope frays in the dark.
The Lantern-Warden walks his rounds.
Maps are drawn of places that no longer exist.
A forger's pen hesitates over your name.
Coins are counted behind a locked grille.
The gravedigger sharpens a spade on stone.
The Ninth Seal is neither warm nor cold.
Somewhere, a folio turns itself.
The court scribe dips his pen in oxblood.
Your Standing is weighed against your sins.
A locked cell forgets its prisoner.
Rain writes on the window ledges.
The Tablet is sealed with nine stamps.
An augur blinks. The digit stays hidden.
The Assize endures. It always does.
